title: How to get to the airport
paragraphs: Every year, thousands of students travel home from Uralsk for university holidays. If you are flying, knowing exactly how to get to Oral Airport — and how to plan your journey efficiently — can make the difference between a stressful trip and a smooth one. In this guide, Kamila Seitkali shares her personal tips for getting to the airport from the WKU campus without any problems.

First, let's talk about timing. Oral Airport is a small regional airport, but it can get surprisingly busy before major holidays. For domestic flights, you should arrive at the airport at least one hour and thirty minutes before your departure time. For international flights, allow at least two hours. Always check your flight details carefully the evening before: confirm the terminal, the gate number, and — most importantly — check whether the departure time has changed. Flight schedules can be updated at the last minute.

From the WKU campus, the most convenient way to reach the airport is by taxi. There is currently no direct public bus route to Oral Airport. Open your Yandex Go or InDrive app, type "Oral Airport" as your destination, and book your ride. The journey normally takes between 12 and 18 minutes depending on traffic, and the price is usually between 1,200 and 1,800 tenge. Tip: book your taxi at least 20 minutes before you need to leave. Don't wait until the last moment — taxis can sometimes be slow to arrive, especially early in the morning.

What should you bring? Always carry your passport — it is your main identification document for domestic flights in Kazakhstan. You will also need your e-ticket, which you can show on your phone or print as a paper copy. Pack your bags the night before if possible. The standard luggage allowance on domestic flights in Kazakhstan is 15–20 kilograms in the hold, plus 5–10 kilograms of hand luggage. Weigh your bags before you leave — if your bag is overweight, you will have to pay an extra charge at the airport, which can be expensive.

At the airport, follow the signs to the Check-in area. Find the desk for your airline, join the queue, and present your passport and e-ticket. The check-in agent will give you a boarding pass, which shows your seat number and the gate number. After check-in, go through Security. Remove your belt, your watch, and any metal objects. Put your laptop and large liquids in a separate tray. Walk through the scanner. If the alarm goes off, stay calm and cooperate with the security officers.

Once you are through security, look at the departure board to find your gate number. Gates are labelled with letters and numbers: for example, "Gate B4". Walk to your gate and wait. Oral Airport is small, so the walk to any gate takes no more than five minutes. Boarding usually starts 30–40 minutes before departure. Listen for announcements and watch the departure board carefully — last-minute gate changes do happen.

A common mistake students make is getting the airport time wrong because they confuse local time and the time shown on their ticket. Kazakhstan has several time zones: Uralsk (West Kazakhstan) uses UTC+5, while Almaty and Astana use UTC+6. If you buy a ticket from an online platform, always check which time zone the departure time is shown in. A one-hour mistake can mean missing your flight completely.

Finally, some general advice: charge your phone the night before (you'll need it for the taxi app and your e-ticket). Set two alarms for the morning — one as a backup. Tell a friend or your parents your flight number and estimated arrival time. And most importantly: relax! Travel is an adventure, and airports — even small ones — are full of the exciting energy of people going somewhere new. Safe travels! ✈️

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Kamila, I'm flying home to Aktobe next Friday. I've never used Oral Airport before. Any tips?

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Sure! First — how are you planning to get there? There's no direct bus, so you'll need a taxi.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: OK. How much is it and how long does it take?

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: About 1,500 tenge and 15 minutes. Use Yandex Go — it's the easiest. Book it 20 minutes before you leave.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Got it. What time should I get to the airport?

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: At least 90 minutes before departure for domestic flights. Don't cut it too close!

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: My flight is at 11:00. So I should leave the dormitory by 9:00 at the latest?

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Yes, that's right. And don't forget your passport — it's required even for domestic flights.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: What about luggage? I have quite a lot — I'm taking gifts home.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Weigh your bag before you go. The limit is usually 15–20 kg. Overweight bags cost extra — quite a lot!

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Good advice! Anything else I should know about the airport itself?

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: It's small and easy to navigate. Follow the signs. After security, find your gate and wait. Simple!

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: You make it sound easy. Thanks, Kamila — you're the best travel advisor!

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Ha! Just don't forget: charge your phone, set two alarms, and enjoy the adventure!

grammarNote:
Направления (directions) даются с помощью повелительного наклонения (imperative) — глагол без подлежащего.

Основные команды:
Turn left / right — поверни налево / направо
Go straight (on) — иди прямо
Cross the road / bridge — перейди дорогу / мост
Take the first / second turning — поверни на первом / втором повороте
Follow the signs — следуй указателям
Go past the (church) — пройди мимо (церкви)
Go along the street — иди вдоль улицы

Ориентиры (landmarks):
It's on your left / right — это слева / справа
It's opposite the library — напротив библиотеки
It's next to the post office — рядом с почтой
You can't miss it! — вы не пропустите!
It's about 5 minutes' walk — около 5 минут пешком

💡 Подсказка: Imperative = просто глагол: "Turn", "Go", "Cross" — без "You"!
